title: Three attack setups, and the counts TrendAI could confirm
intro: TrendAI’s English report of 27 October describes three infrastructures aimed mainly at Japan. Move across them. Each figure is a lower bound from files on the attackers’ own servers.
note: These are lower-bound estimates, not a full census, and not a count of confirmed breaches. The report says the actual numbers may be higher. For many CyberStrikeAI targets the platform recorded no session, no web shell and no exfiltration. Case C’s use of AI is a high-confidence reading of writing style, not a recovered prompt. The Japanese article was 23 October; this English edition is 27 October.
